acceptanceCriteria.reason: Two sequential protocol-stub Runs exercised docker-desktop-run-container on the Apple silicon Mac Mini.
This receipt records the host, Docker Desktop, image, Agentis SHA, Codex pin, exact commands, and sanitized Run receipts.
Each Run used its own named and labeled container and its own runs/<run-id> workspace. No bind source exposed owner.token or broad host /tmp.
The no-stub Darwin attempt failed closed before Docker created a container. Live Codex remains UNVERIFIED with the exact missing prerequisites.
The probe changed no external resource, mounted no owner credential, stopped both daemons, and left no Run container.

repairAcceptanceCriteria.reason: The two /workspace bind sources were distinct and ended in scratch/runs/<run-id>.
The canceled container disappeared in 822 ms. The succeeded container disappeared in 623 ms.
The only bind sources were each private Run workspace and the exact read-only protocol-stub file. No source was /tmp or /private/tmp, and no source contained the owner credential.
Without the stub, Darwin returned the Linux payload, container-scoped authentication, and provider network prerequisite error before any Docker container-create event. Live Codex remains UNVERIFIED.

The repaired head retains the focused container and store regression tests and the isolated protocol-stub fixture evidence recorded in docs/verification/kat-3242.md. The Mini re-verification did not rerun the Linux test suite.
